title: Rework package (what the builder receives on bounce-back)
description: Written by ./scripts/storyline apply (verify-merge, or advance on a G5a/G5b rejection) to .storyline/out/<slug>/rework-<n>.json — local, never committed. The build handoff tells tines-builder to read it first, fix only the listed findings, and use each finding's suggested_prompt. The builder and the reviewers share one cap of 3 rework cycles (state-machine.yaml caps.rework_cap); at the cap the story opens GX. A human 'request changes' on the PR resets the cap. Spec: REPO-DESIGN.md §4.4 (04 verify).

failing_gate.description: G4 = verify-merge returned changes_requested; G5a/G5b = the release or the change request was rejected (the approver's note becomes a finding)

attempt.description: The attempt this package opens (n in rework-<n>.json); the tracker row's attempt after the transition

source_ref.description: storyline/work/<slug>/verify-report.json for G4, storyline/work/<slug>/ship.md for G5a/G5b

suggested_prompt.description: A ready /tines-build-story <slug> "<prompt>" naming the story, the action type, the action name and the fields; when a source gave none, verify-merge writes one from the message

prior_attempts.description: One entry per earlier package for this story in this iteration, oldest first, so the builder does not repeat a fix that already failed

instructions.const: Fix only the listed findings and failing cases. Each finding carries a suggested_prompt. Two failed corrections on one issue: stop and report (GX). Then validate, run the test event, export, and commit on the same story branch.
